'''Alejandro Peribañez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[April 2001 Madrid tournament (21 April, second event)]] on 21 April 2001 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal is getting weird 4.0 (Dark Deal with TIE retrieval, Occupation)]], according to Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2133">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-ithor-madrid-04-21-01d2133/ ithor-madrid-04-21-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 23 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-ithor-madrid-04-21-01d2133/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
